quarterly_data.signal: Fabrinet's 10-K states that the remaining balance on the new manufacturing building project at its Chonburi campus (construction began in February 2025) was approximately $39.7 million as of June 26, 2026. During fiscal 2026 Fabrinet also acquired an additional facility in Pathum Thani, Thailand, which is currently undergoing renovation and is expected to support future manufacturing capacity upon completion.
quarterly_data.figure: Chonburi building project ~$39.7 million remaining as of June 26, 2026; Pathum Thani facility acquired in fiscal 2026 (under renovation)

quarterly_data.signal: Fabrinet's capital expenditures (including accrued amounts) were $298,921 thousand in the year ended June 26, 2026, versus $130,658 thousand in the year ended June 27, 2025 and $49,270 thousand in the year ended June 28, 2024; during fiscal 2026 it invested in new manufacturing buildings at the Chonburi and Pathum Thani campuses and equipment for expansion of its manufacturing facilities in Thailand. Fabrinet expects fiscal 2027 capital expenditures to increase compared with fiscal 2026, mainly due to the purchase of a new manufacturing building in California, continued investment at the Pathum Thani campus and equipment to expand manufacturing capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex $298,921 thousand (year ended June 26, 2026) vs $130,658 thousand (year ended June 27, 2025) and $49,270 thousand (year ended June 28, 2024); fiscal 2027 capex expected to increase
